Seasonal C7 design

The classic bulb, done properly. Bulbs are spaced and clipped to follow your roofline precisely, with trees, railings and entrances composed into one display. Installed in November, removed and stored in January.

Permanent track lighting

A slim aluminum track colour-matched to your trim, with individually controlled LEDs inside. Warm white for everyday evenings, or any colour for holidays and game nights, all from your phone.

Recent installations

Real homes across Oakville and the GTA. Track lighting that disappears by day and comes alive at night in any colour.

Why it matters

Lighting is the one exterior upgrade people see every single night.

Presence

A clean, continuous line defines the architecture after dark and sets your home apart on the street.

Ease

No ladders, no seasonal storage, no tangled cords. Schedules run themselves and the app handles the rest.

We design, install, maintain and remove your display, then store it safely until next season.

Care

Rooflines are dangerous work. Our technicians are trained, insured and tidy, and we stand behind every install.

The process

Simple from first call to final switch-on.

  1. Consultation

    We visit, measure the roofline and listen to what you want.

  2. Design

    You choose colours and placement. We confirm a fixed quote.

  3. Installation

    Most homes are completed in a day, and we leave the property spotless.

  4. Handover

    We set up your app, schedules and scenes, and walk you through them.

    We set your timers, switch on the display and walk you through it.

  5. Ongoing care

    Service is a phone call away whenever you need an adjustment.

    Service is a phone call away all season. In January we take your display down and store it for you.
